fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-07-16 (afternoon, 13:10): The complainant bought a maroon scooter bearing registration number TN-39-YY-1049 for Rs. 4,00,000 and later found that the documents shown by the seller were doubtful. Jagan Arumugam approached Namakkal East PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000008. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100095. A witness, Madhan Kumar, reachable on 9000000410, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes transaction records, a vehicle observation and physical documents.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Transaction record; Vehicle observation; Physical document
fields.Modus_Operandi: Seller reportedly shared doubtful papers and stopped responding.
fields.Keywords: vehicle sale, cheating, afternoon, highway junction, witness, scooter, receiving account, transaction record
